title: Patchoulol GC Sample Preparation
author: Dennis DD Dienst
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xivfke6

steps.title: Store Stock Solutions
steps.instruction: Store stock solutions in the refrigerator at approximately 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Patchoulol External Standard Dilution Series
steps.instruction: Prepare a high range dilution series of Patchoulol external standard (ES) with concentrations of 0, 25, 50, 100, 200, 400, and 800 µg*µL-1 using Stock II and Stock C in 200 µL transfers to vials.

substeps.instruction: For 800 µg*mL-1: Combine 400 µL Stock II and 0 µL Stock C
For 400 µg*mL-1: Combine 250 µL Stock II and 250 µL Stock C
For 200 µg*mL-1: Combine 125.0 µL Stock II and 375.0 µL Stock C
For 100 µg*mL-1: Combine 62.5 µL Stock II and 437.5 µL Stock C
For 50 µg*mL-1: Combine 31.25 µL Stock II and 468.75 µL Stock C
For 25 µg*mL-1: Combine 15.63 µL Stock II and 484.38 µL Stock C
For 0 µg*mL-1: Combine 0.0 µL Stock II and 500.0 µL Stock C

steps.title: Prepare GC Sample Vials
steps.instruction: Prepare the GC vials by adding the sample and internal standard.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 198 µL of sample into the GC vial
